description: This file is a Bash script used for testing and orchestrating the installation and switching of different service entrypoints for the 'openclaw' application within a Docker environment. It builds a Docker image, sets up stub systemd and loginctl commands, installs a local npm package, and runs testing flows to verify correct entrypoint configurations.

methods.name: assert_entrypoint
methods.description: Verifies that the systemd unit file has the correct ExecStart entrypoint.

methods.name: run_flow
methods.description: Runs a test flow: installs service, verifies entrypoint, switches to another entrypoint, and verifies again.
